cohort: 124 women scheduled for elective caesarean surgery under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: A weight-adjusted dose of ondansetron (0.1mg/kg) reduced the severity of shivering compared to a fixed 4mg dose in women undergoing spinal anaesthesia for caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: A weight-adjusted dose of ondansetron was found to reduce the severity of shivering following spinal anaesthesia for caesarean deliveries.
